svg.title: U01 coordinate join: historical frame versus normalized prospective generation
svg.desc: Conditional ordinary generation-competition geometry in a saved historical descriptor frame. The black circle is the fixed 150-native-unit research boundary. No historical joint winner, terrain or final UI catalogue is asserted.

g.text: U01 · a coordinate join does not preserve a procedural seed
Feynman V Cu Co Ni IL · source 0:25116:32436:0029d20d · build 1.16.244.0
Both panels use the source anchor as (0,0), generator origin (−200,−200), X right / Y up and the same scale.
The 150-unit circle is the same historical reference disk. Only the left geometry uses the historical descriptor frame.
Historical-frame conditional model
Descriptor (25152,32448); original generator origin (−3800,−1400)
X → native units
Y ↑
Normalized prospective native execution
Descriptor (25116,32436); original generator origin (−200,−200)
X → native units
Y ↑
Left: 30 retained paths. Right: 28 retained paths. Equal display origins do not make these populations interchangeable.
Historical source-relative centre = (883.460693359375, 1067.887710571289). Its circle is a reference on the prospective panel.
Packed-key cell (1,1): historical seed XY (21353,31049); prospective seed XY (24917,32237). No /100 correction is applied.
The map transform is reversible: native point = source-relative point + source anchor; outpost-relative point = native point − centre.
Black circle / cross / diamond: historical research disk, saved native centre and saved beacon. Native points/bounds stay exact in JSON.
Resource colors: IRES TINC. Competition footprint reconstruction approximates marginal native floating-point boundaries.
The left model is not an observed full historical source population. Four independent primary callback paths match native evidence.
